criterion: Writes a design specification under docs/plans/ (or complete design specification in the response) without modifying files in profiledb/.
References profiledb/repository.py (UserProfileStore, LegacyProfile) and identifies how v1 and v2 readers/writers interact on the same underlying records.
Evaluates at least two migration strategies (such as dual-write with lazy read-repair backfill vs eager stop-the-world batch conversion vs versioned view adapters) and their trade-offs.
Specifies how writes from v1 callers keep v2 fields synchronized (and vice versa) during the transition phase so rollbacks do not lose updates.
Defines unit test cases for mixed v1/v2 read-after-write consistency, background backfill completion, and contract-phase cutover.
